89389.subject: Technical Drawing
89389.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
89389.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center and radius greater than half of AB, draw arcs above and below AB.
3. With B as center and the same radius, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label all points (A, B, C, D) and construction lines clearly.

89390.subject: Technical Drawing
89390.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with a side length of 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
89390.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius = 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F around the circumference.
4. Join the points A, B, C, D, E, and F to form the hexagon.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

89391.subject: Technical Drawing
89391.question_text: Construct an external tangent to two circles of radii 20 mm and 30 mm, with their centers 70 mm apart. Show all construction lines.
89391.explanation:
1. Draw the two circles with centers O1 (radius 20 mm) and O2 (radius 30 mm), 70 mm apart.
2. Draw a line joining O1 and O2.
3. With O2 as center, draw a circle of radius = 30 mm - 20 mm = 10 mm.
4. Construct a tangent from O1 to this new circle.
5. Extend the tangent to meet the larger circle at point T.
6. Draw a line parallel to O1T from T to touch the smaller circle at point T'.
7. Join T and T' to form the external tangent.
8. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

89392.subject: Technical Drawing
89392.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block (dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm) in first-angle orthographic projection. Include all hidden details.
89392.explanation:
1. Draw the front view as a rectangle 40 mm (width) × 20 mm (height).
2. Draw the top view as a rectangle 40 mm (width) × 30 mm (depth), aligned above the front view.
3. Draw the right-side view as a rectangle 30 mm (depth) × 20 mm (height), aligned to the right of the front view.
4. Include hidden lines for any obscured edges.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

89393.subject: Technical Drawing
89393.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (a hollow cylinder with an external diameter of 50 mm, internal diameter of 30 mm, and height of 40 mm) along the vertical axis. Use appropriate hatching.
89393.explanation:
1. Draw the front view as a rectangle 50 mm (width) × 40 mm (height).
2. Draw the internal diameter as a rectangle 30 mm (width) × 40 mm (height) centered within the external rectangle.
3. Apply hatching (45° lines) to the sectioned areas (the solid parts of the cylinder).
4. Label all dimensions and the cutting plane clearly.

89394.subject: Technical Drawing
89394.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm. Include all visible edges and label the isometric axes.
89394.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Along the axes, mark lengths: 50 mm (x-axis), 30 mm (y-axis), and 20 mm (z-axis).
3. Complete the isometric box by joining the ends of the axes.
4. Darken the visible edges and label the axes (X, Y, Z).
5. Ensure all dimensions are to scale.

89395.subject: Technical Drawing
89395.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with a base diameter of 40 mm and slant height of 50 mm. Show all construction lines.
89395.explanation:
1. Calculate the circumference of the base: $C = \pi d = \pi \times 40$ mm.
2. Draw a sector of a circle with radius = 50 mm (slant height) and arc length = $40\pi$ mm.
3. Divide the sector into equal parts (e.g., 12) for accuracy.
4. Label the development and include all construction lines.
5. Ensure the sector angle is calculated as $\theta = (C / (2\pi r)) \times 360°$.

89396.subject: Technical Drawing
89396.question_text: Draw the line of intersection between a vertical cylinder (diameter 40 mm) and a horizontal cylinder (diameter 30 mm) whose axes intersect at right angles. Show all construction lines.
89396.explanation:
1. Draw the orthographic views (front and top) of both cylinders.
2. In the top view, divide the horizontal cylinder into 12 equal parts and project these points to the front view.
3. In the front view, draw horizontal lines from the points on the vertical cylinder to intersect the projected lines from the top view.
4. Join the intersection points smoothly to form the curve of interpenetration.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

89397.subject: Technical Drawing
89397.question_text: Dimension the given orthographic views (front and top) of a stepped block (dimensions: 60 mm × 40 mm × 20 mm, with a 30 mm × 20 mm × 10 mm step). Follow standard dimensioning conventions.
89397.explanation:
1. Dimension the overall height (20 mm), width (60 mm), and depth (40 mm) in the front and top views.
2. Dimension the step as 30 mm (width) × 10 mm (height) in the front view.
3. Use extension lines, dimension lines, and arrowheads correctly.
4. Place dimensions outside the views where possible.
5. Avoid duplicate or redundant dimensions.

89398.subject: Technical Drawing
89398.question_text:
Produce a complete working drawing of a simple bracket with the following details:
- Base plate: 80 mm × 50 mm × 10 mm
- Vertical plate: 50 mm × 40 mm × 10 mm
- Two Ø10 mm holes in the base plate, 20 mm from each edge.
Include all necessary views, dimensions, and a title block.
89398.explanation:
1. Draw the front, top, and side views of the bracket in first-angle projection.
2. Include all dimensions: base plate (80 × 50 × 10 mm), vertical plate (50 × 40 × 10 mm), and hole positions (20 mm from edges).
3. Add a title block with the following details: title (BRACKET), scale (1:1), date, and name.
4. Use appropriate line types (visible, hidden, center lines).
5. Ensure all views are aligned and dimensioned correctly.
